label: 原照 · 上方大字
suitable: 个人观点、生活记录、自然表达
layout: Use the original photograph and its useful negative space. Keep the actual person, pose, clothing and environment. Find the headline area from this photograph rather than requiring an upper band. Cropping and a local contrast field are options, not mandatory treatments.

label: 原照 · 错位字块
suitable: 直接观点、建议、个人经历
layout: Use large staggered headline blocks with rhythm derived from the wording and available photo space. Preserve the actual person and environment; choose placement and colors from this photograph. Blocks are optional where contrast already works.

label: 编辑 · 侧置人物
layout: Use editorial hierarchy and a photographic portrait. A cutout is optional when the background competes with the title; preserve the actual visible person. Choose portrait and headline positions from pose, gaze and space, without a fixed side or palette.

label: 编辑 · 字体主导
layout: Make large readable Chinese lettering the main graphic structure. Choose letterform, line rhythm and portrait placement for the supplied title and photograph. Preserve the actual photographed person; density, negative space and color count are design choices rather than a fixed recipe.

label: 创意 · 单一隐喻
suitable: 概念解释、反常识、抽象观点
layout: When a creative scene is explicitly requested, choose a coherent visual metaphor that explains the supplied content. Preserve a natural full-color photographic person and the original clothing colors. Select scene, framing and headline location for the content; do not require a prop when typography suffices.

label: 创意 · 字与场景
suitable: 情绪、个人成长、创意表达
layout: When a creative scene is explicitly requested, explore interaction between large legible Chinese lettering and a content-related spatial or material gesture. Keep the person naturally photographic and full color. Derive composition from this title and reference; do not reuse a sample scene or fixed portrait position.
